|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Bane, The Bounty Hunter. The later version [[Cad Bane (Virtual Block 6)]] (PC-E1, the current card) is titled •Cad Bane with the same game text. The release-sheet slip on this page prints •Bane, The Bounty Hunter; the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image print •Cad Bane (see [[Cad Bane (Virtual Block 6)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): titled “•Bane, The Bounty Hunter” (no lore) on the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet, slip 3•01: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Ponda Baba's Hold-out Blaster deploys and fires for free on Bane. Once per turn, if Bane just used a weapon to hit a character, may 'annihilate' target (target is placed out of play when forfeited this battle).”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010), page 2, slip 301. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-01-Cad_Bane.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1263_1-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “Bane, The Bounty Hunter”</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Cad Bane (Virtual Block 6)]]): The rename is not in the [[Players Committee]]'s “New Persona Changes” list of 29 January 2013<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1263_1-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313220753/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-03-13] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130426080051/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-04-26] (Internet Archive): “Cad Bane” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 5) prints the card as “•Cad Bane” (lore “Bounty hunter.”)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=5, page 5. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Ponda Baba's Hold-out Blaster deploys and fires for free on Bane. Once per turn, if Bane just used a weapon to hit a character, may 'annihilate' target (target is placed out of play when forfeited this battle).” The game text did not change. The slip has no lore (“bounty hunter” was in the title); the Master List adds the lore “Bounty hunter.”. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1263-1-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-cadbane-pre.gif]]) print it.
